Sandbox_VargursVampires_Enabled_tooltip: Enables or disables all Vargur's Vampires gameplay.
Sandbox_VargursVampires_DifficultyPreset: Actually Too Hard You Will Die
Overrides individual settings with the selected difficulty preset. Keep as Custom to use your own settings. See Steam Workshop page for details.
Sandbox_VargursVampires_BloodLoot_toolti: Amount of human blood bottles in medical loot. Uses the vanilla loot amount range. Default: 0.6
Sandbox_VargursVampires_VampireHealthReg: Multiplies native health regeneration for vampires. 1.0 uses the original rates; 0 disables this regeneration. Default: 1.5
Sandbox_VargursVampires_SunDamageEnabled: Enables all sunlight damage systems for vampire characters.
Sandbox_VargursVampires_SunBurnRandomCha: Chance per eligible uncovered body part per game-minute check. 0.01 means 1 percent (1 in 100); 0 disables random burns and 1 guarantees them.
Sandbox_VargursVampires_SunAttenuationCl: Fraction of sunlight blocked at maximum cloud intensity. 0 gives no cloud protection; 1 blocks all sunlight at maximum cloud intensity. Default: 0.4
Sandbox_VargursVampires_SunAttenuationPr: Fraction of sunlight blocked at maximum precipitation intensity. 0 gives no precipitation protection; 1 blocks all sunlight at maximum intensity. Default: 0.7
Sandbox_VargursVampires_SunAttenuationFo: Fraction of sunlight blocked at maximum fog intensity. 0 gives no fog protection; 1 blocks all sunlight at maximum fog intensity. Default: 0.6
Sandbox_VargursVampires_SunAttenuationVe: Fraction of sunlight blocked inside a vehicle. 0 gives no vehicle protection; 1 blocks all sunlight. Default: 0.9 (90 percent protection, 10 percent exposure).
Sandbox_VargursVampires_SunEnvironmental: Scales environmental sunlight after weather, position, and vehicle protection, before clothing and the local UV cutoff. 1.1 for example is 10 percent stronger. Default: 1
Sandbox_VargursVampires_SunDaylightCurve: Lower values ramp up exposure faster during dawn and dusk. Default: 0.5.
Sandbox_VargursVampires_SunNoonIntensity: Extra sunlight intensity centered on solar noon. Default: 0.4.
The spread of additional time around noon where the extra sunlight intensity is applied. Default: 0.6
Sandbox_VargursVampires_SunDamagePerMinu: Full-body damage at intensity multiplier 1.0 per in-game minute. Damage can be increased around noon and decreased with other times of day, weather, vehicle, and clothing protections.
Sandbox_VargursVampires_Uninstall_toolti: Set to 1 before removing this mod from a save and ideally back up your save first. This will disable all mod gameplay and remove the mod's traits, items, fluids and saved data from players when they load in, logging each change to console.txt. After all players have logged in, you can save, quit and remove the mod. Takes effect when the save is loaded. Offline multiplayer characters are only cleaned when they next join. Skill levels gained from the Vampire trait are kept. Default: 0
